user.title: Nebula
user.description:
Set up the Nebula bridge. This exposes a combined room / scene / automation feed for the Nebula app and panel, advertises this instance on the LAN, and adds connection sensors.

After setup, scan the QR in the **Pair the Nebula app** notification with the Nebula Home app.

pair_code.name: Generate pairing code
pair_code.description: Rotates the Nebula pairing code and re-raises the "Pair the Nebula app" notification with a fresh QR to scan. The code is single-use and valid ~30 minutes. You normally don't need this — the notification appears on its own until an app has paired.
